The Petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the  Memorandum of grounds filed in support thereof and the order of the High  Court dated 03.03.2023, 23.12.2023, 12.01.2024, 12.12.2025 & 23.01.2026  made herein and  upon hearing the arguments of Sri SANJAY SURANENI,
 Advocate for the Petitioners and of ASSISTANT PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, for  the Respondent, the Court made the following;
ORDER:
Heard Sri Rajesh Batra, learned counsel assisted by Sri Sanjay Suraneni, learned counsel for the petitioners.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor requests some time to make his submissions.
At his request, Post on 20.02.2026.
Interim order, granted earlier, is extended till the next date of hearing.
